text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
—So pretty...! Is she an actress or 
something? —Is the girl next to her a 
bodyguard? —Both of them have quite an 
aura, don't they...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off. Hearing some commotion, I 
looked over and saw Mejiro Ramonu and 
Symboli Kris S.
choice_data_list: Hey there. You two heading out together?
Oh my. Going out together, you two?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes. With her guiding the way.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Aqua and Liquid and Water." It boasts 
every kind of premium water. Good water is 
essential for an athlete.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems their destination is a specialty 
water shop. As a Trainer who oversees body 
conditioning, I'm curious to see what kind 
of shop it is.
choice_data_list: Can I come along with you, too?
May I come along with you, too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...As you wish.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping inside, they found shelf after 
shelf lined with famous waters gathered 
from all over the world. The three of them 
looked around together, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, that shelf. You recommended it before.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... If beauty is the goal—that is 
optimal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it wasn't bad. Though it left me 
wanting more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I responded that way, Symboli Kris S 
walked away from the spot without saying a 
word.
choice_data_list:
(From the looks of it, could she be 
angry...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh. There's a cafe here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Paying no mind to Symboli Kris S as she 
walked away, Mejiro Ramonu settled in to 
relax at the adjoining cafe.
choice_data_list:
Aren't you curious how Symboli Kris S is 
doing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Why?
choice_data_list:
I thought your words might have hurt 
them...

Thinking you might have been hurt by those 
words...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Really? It's the same as always.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Besides, it should be about time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for waiting. I had them bring 
out... the imports from France."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It's rich in silica—and magnesium too. 
Good for—post-workout—hydration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this will do. Thank you for going 
through the trouble.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: No problem—it's business as usual.
choice_data_list: (Kris S doesn't seem bothered by it...?)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ……Hm? You look suspicious――don't you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
He seemed worried. Thought the way I put 
things made you uncomfortable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"She seemed worried. Thinking the way I 
spoke might have upset you."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Through Ramonu's—words—...? Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: So far—... I haven't really—felt that way.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu—doesn't explain—very much. Her 
words are—concise—short and comfortable.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
And also—they are sharp. They 
understand—my intentions immediately.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you... I've been saved. With you 
as my... roommate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, really?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the two of them seemingly sharing a 
laugh brought a wave of relief. They 
appeared to understand each other much 
better than I had thought.
choice_data_list:
Are we going somewhere else together after 
this?

Are the two of us going somewhere else 
after this?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see... Nearby—... There's an 
obstacle course—I go to a lot."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"There's a hotel I frequent. Their oil 
massage treatments are divine."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
“Still, considering the time we have to 
head back, I suppose we should choose just 
one.”
choice_data_list:
In that case, why don't you treat them to 
an aesthetic spa?

Exercising on the athletics course looks 
like so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Mm. I am alsoâcurious. About 
yourâ"usual haunt."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Right. It's settled then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Aromatherapy scents—you can choose them, 
huh...? Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: If you can't decide, how about lavender?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I heard that both of 
them felt completely rejuvenated by the 
massage.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Could I ask you to show me 
the way?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
On this courseâwho is faster? Time 
trialâmatchâshall we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh. Sounds interesting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I watched over Mejiro Ramonu and 
the others with a warm smile as they 
competed fiercely, spurring one another on 
to greater heights.
